## Finnish Horseshoe

- Original horseshoe favors 0 or $\hat \beta$ as solutions

- When coefficients are poorly identified, it's helpful to add additional regulation for the largest coefficients

- The *regularized* horseshoe shrinks all coefficients by at least a small amount

[Sparsity information and regularization in the horseshoe and other shrinkage priors](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.01694.pdf)

## R2-D2 Prior

- R2-induced Dirichlet decomposition (R2-D2)

- A typical approach: specify a p-dimensional prior on all regression coefficients

-  Alternative: specify a prior on $R^2$ and then conditionally on $\beta$

    + For a fixed $R^2$, $\beta$ lies on an ellipsoid

[Bayesian Regression Using a Prior on the Model Fit: The R2-D2 Shrinkage Prior](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/01621459.2020.1825449)

## Simulation

- $n = 50$, $p=100$

- All coefficients are zero except for three of them

- Coefficients 2,4, and 6 have value 2

- Compare Gaussian, Laplace and Horseshoe priors using rstanarm.

```{r data_gen, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
library(rstanarm)
n <- 50
p <- 100
beta <- rep(0, p)
beta[1:3] <- 2
x <- matrix(rnorm(n*p), nrow=n)
x <- as.matrix(apply(x, 2, scale))
y <- rnorm(n=n, mean=x %*% beta, sd=1)

p0 <- 10
tau0 <- p0/(p-p0) * 1/sqrt(n)
fit_hs <- stan_glm(y~x, gaussian(), prior=hs(global_scale=tau0, slab_scale=2.5, slab_df=4), data=tibble(x=x,y=y))

posterior <- as.matrix(fit_hs)
hs_dens <- mcmc_areas(posterior, pars=paste0("x", 1:10)) + xlim(c(-3, 3)) + ggtitle("Horseshoe")
hs_dens
```


## Gaussian Laplace fits
```{r, dependson="data_gen", cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
fit_gaus <- stan_glm(y~x, gaussian(), prior=normal(scale=1), data=tibble(x=x,y=y))
posterior_gaus <- as.matrix(fit_gaus)
gaus_dens <- mcmc_areas(posterior_gaus, pars=paste0("x", 1:10)) + xlim(c(-5, 5)) + ggtitle("Gaussian")

fit_lap <- stan_glm(y~x, gaussian(), prior=laplace(scale=1), data=tibble(x=x,y=y))
posterior_lap <- as.matrix(fit_lap)
lap_dens <- mcmc_areas(posterior_lap, pars=paste0("x", 1:10)) + xlim(c(-5, 5)) + ggtitle("Laplace")
```

## R2-D2 Fit
```{r, dependson="data_gen", cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
library(brms)
options(mc.cores=4)
brm_fit <- brm(y ~ x, data=tibble(y=y, x=x), 
               prior=set_prior(R2D2(mean_R2 = 0.5, prec_R2 = 2, 
                                    cons_D2 = 0.1)), 
               family=gaussian())
r2d2_dens <- mcmc_plot(brm_fit, type="areas", variable = paste0("b_x", 1:10)) + ggtitle("R2-D2") + xlim(c(-3, 3))
```

## Comparison Plots
